friendlyTitle: ConardLi/garden-skills: six agent skills, from a short video to a local search
summary: garden-skills was the next unpublished AI repository on GitHub's daily trending page, with 241 stars in that window and 14,068 in total. It is MIT-licensed. The README calls it a curated set of agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other coding agents, and the badge counts six. The gallery lists a code-rendered short video, a web video or presentation, a web-design skill, an image-prompting skill, a skill that turns a source into an article, and a local knowledge retriever.

whyItMatters: Use it when you want a small, named skill instead of a long prompt for one of those six jobs. Six skills is a short list, which makes it easier to read before you install. Check the license and what each skill calls out to. A local knowledge skill is not the same as an image skill that may send a prompt to a model API.
